name: Mythic Brawler
diceAnatomy: 1-3 = Fist (A), 4-5 = Spirit (B), 6 = Peak (C). Vérifié leaflet Screenshot_39 (scan user 2026-07-16).
source: Board (2 photos + Screenshot_40 ultimate) + leaflet (3 captures) + 15 cartes (kit complet confirmé user 2026-07-16). Spec : characters/Mythic_Brawler/SPEC.md. Rulings user 2026-07-16 : aucun jeton de départ ; deck = 15 cartes héros + communes ; pas d'upgrade Strong Arm/Healing Wind ; Strong Arm égalité = attaquant gagne (equal or greater).

tokens.name: Strength of the Ocean
tokens.description: Unique Status Effect. À l'Upkeep, 1×/tour, dépense : 1 jeton -> +1 CP ; 2 jetons -> +1 CP et Heal 2. Non transférable, retirable.

tokens.name: Strength of the Mountain
tokens.description: Unique Status Effect. +1 dmg d'Attaque par jeton. Attack Modifier. Persistent.

tokens.name: Strength of the Sky
tokens.description: Unique Status Effect. +1 dé lancé par jeton en activant la Defensive Ability. Persistent.

tokens.name: Concussion
tokens.description: Negative Status Effect. Le porteur SAUTE sa prochaine Income Phase puis retire le jeton.

abilities.notes: After targeting an opponent, you each roll 1 die: si mon jet >= au sien, gain 1 Strength puis 6 dmg ; sinon 7 dmg. baseDamage = espérance (21/36 x 6 + 15/36 x 7).
Gain Ocean. 6 dmg et lance 1 dé : Fist +2 dmg ; Spirit pioche 1 ; Peak inflige Concussion. II : lance 2 dés, +2 dmg PAR Fist, On Spirit pioche 1, On Peak Concussion.
5 dmg (II : 6). Sur 4-of-a-kind (chiffres) inflige Concussion ; II : sur 3-of-a-kind gain Sky, sur 4-of-a-kind AUSSI Concussion.
Gain 1 Strength. Puis 7 dmg. II : 8 dmg, et si un 6 est utilisé dans la suite, Heal 1.
I : CHOIX gain Mountain OU retirer 1 Mountain pour +3 dmg à cette Attaque ; puis 10 dmg. II : gain Mountain ; puis 12 dmg.
Gain 2 Strengths. Inflige Concussion. Puis 12 dmg. Ultimate standard (indéfendable).

altAbilities.notes: Gain 2 Strengths. Inflige Concussion. (Pas de dégâts.) Ajoutée par Ancestral Strength II.
3 dmg INDÉFENDABLES. Ajoutée par Tectonic Punch II.

defense.name: Wrassle
defense.text: Defense Roll 2 (II : 3 ; +1 dé par Strength of the Sky). Deal 1 dmg x Fist. Heal 1 x Spirit. On Peak, gain 1 Strength.

cards.name: Clobber II
cards.text: AAAA: Deal 6 dmg. AAAAA: Deal 7 dmg. On 3-of-a-kind (#'s), gain Strength of the Sky. On 4-of-a-kind (#'s), also inflict Concussion.

cards.name: Tidal Blow II
cards.text: AAABB: Gain Strength of the Ocean. Deal 6 dmg and roll 2 dice: Add 2 x Fist dmg. On Spirit, draw 1. On Peak, inflict Concussion.

cards.name: Ancestral Strength II
cards.text: CCCC: Gain 2 Strengths. Then deal 9 undefendable dmg. Adds alt SPIRIT CALL (CCC): Gain 2 Strengths. Inflict Concussion.

cards.name: Spirit Strike II
cards.text: SMALL STRAIGHT: Gain 1 Strength. Then deal 8 dmg. If you use a 6 in this straight, Heal 1.

cards.name: Tectonic Punch II
cards.text: LARGE STRAIGHT: Gain Strength of the Mountain. Then deal 12 dmg. Adds alt KNOCK OUT (ABBC): Deal 3 undefendable dmg.

cards.name: Wrassle II
cards.text: Defense Roll 3. Deal 1 x Fist dmg. Heal 1 x Spirit. On Peak, gain 1 Strength.

cards.name: Sea Song!
cards.text: Instant Action. Remove Strength of the Ocean to gain 2 CP.

cards.name: Haka!
cards.text: Instant Action. Gain 1 Strength. You may spend an additional 2 CP to gain 2 Strengths instead.

cards.name: Heavy Hand!
cards.text: Roll Phase Action. Change the value of one of your dice to 1, 2, or 3.

cards.name: Kapu!
cards.text: Roll Phase Action. Play only after being Attacked. Remove Strength of the Mountain to prevent 4 incoming dmg.

cards.name: Flying Punch!
cards.text: Roll Phase Action. Attack Modifier. Remove a Strength of the Sky to make this Attack undefendable.

cards.name: Wild Strength!
cards.text: Roll Phase Action. Attack Modifier. Roll 5 dice: For every 2 Fists, add 2 dmg. You may re-roll up to one of these dice per Strength (up to 5 total).

cards.name: Enjoy the View!
cards.text: Main Phase Action. Choose one: Gain Strength of the Sky, or Heal 2.

cards.name: Explosive Flex!
cards.text: Main Phase Action. Choose one: Gain Strength of the Mountain, or deal 2 dmg to a chosen opponent.

cards.name: Spirit Chant!
cards.text: Main Phase Action. Roll 1 die: On Fist, inflict Concussion on a chosen opponent. On Spirit, draw 2. On Peak, gain 2 Strengths.
